required: test/ci-local.sh passes on the exact candidate commit.
An independent reviewer approves that same commit.
GitHub Actions billing evidence confirms affected jobs started with zero steps rather than reporting a code failure.

temporary_remote_ci_exception.reason: Repository Actions jobs cannot start while the account is blocked by billing or quota.
temporary_remote_ci_exception.approved_substitute: Exact-SHA local CI plus independent review.
temporary_remote_ci_exception.limits: A zero-step remote job is not a passing check. The exception authorizes publication validation only and does not weaken the nine checks configured for future main protection.

publication_blocked_until: Every Git ref selected for publication has passed secret and private-path review.
Open branches, pull requests, issues, discussions, Wiki pages, Projects, commit metadata, Actions logs and artifacts, and historical artifacts have been reviewed for public disclosure.
The exact origin/main candidate satisfies candidate_validation, including test/ci-local.sh and independent review.
The approved history-cleanup plan has completed, GitHub-managed PR references have been purged or explicitly accepted, and all retained refs point only to the rewritten history.
pablontiv is the only direct collaborator and there are no pending invitations, deploy keys, unapproved write-capable apps, or webhooks.
The operator has approved the exact SHA-256 digest of this manifest immediately before rollout.

manual_operations.verification: A fresh settings read shows issue creation restricted to collaborators.

verification: Visibility is public only after all preconditions and pre-public requests pass.
Issues and pull requests both show Collaborators only; pablontiv remains the sole collaborator.
Discussions, Projects, and Wiki are disabled.
Only squash merge is enabled and web commits require signoff.
main protection applies to administrators, requires all nine app-bound checks, signed commits, linear history, and resolved conversations, and rejects force pushes and deletion.
Actions permits only GitHub-owned actions pinned by full SHA and uses a read-only workflow token.
Secret scanning, push protection, non-provider patterns, validity checks, vulnerability alerts, security updates, private reporting, CodeQL extended setup, and immutable releases report enabled.
A failed request or mismatched reread stops rollout; there is no automatic retry.
